content: While scholars vary in how they define critical thinking, a strong consensus emerges around several interrelated core features: it is purposeful and goal-directed; grounded in sound reasoning and evidence; practiced deliberately through learned cognitive skills; informed by ongoing self-reflection and intellectual humility; and oriented toward reasoned, context-sensitive judgment.
